title: Kolaboro off-plan data, November 2026

headlines.text: 8.2% of tracked off-plan projects with a usable handover date (62 of 755) are past the first handover date on record.
Median time past the first handover date among those 62 projects: 10.5 months (90th percentile: 35 months).
4.1% (31 of 755) are past the handover date their sellers advertise today.
Median transparency index across 95 markets with 3 or more tracked projects: 42 out of 100.
Advertised asking-price index, all tracked markets: 100.03 on 2026-11-03 (base 100 on 2026-10-28, same-project pairs only).

paragraph.text: Kolaboro data for November 2026 cover 896 off-plan projects in 144 markets. Of the 755 projects with a usable handover date that are not completed, 62 (8.2%) are past the first handover date on record, with a median of 10.5 months and a 90th percentile of 35 months past that date. 31 (4.1%) are past the date their sellers advertise today. The median transparency index across 95 markets with 3 or more projects is 42 out of 100. The advertised asking-price index for all tracked markets stood at 100.03 on 2026-11-03, against a base of 100 on 2026-10-28. History for the delay index starts this month.
